title: She Kept Taking My Lunch. I Relabeled It.
script: Still missing? My name was already on the container, in the office fridge, for three weeks before someone started eating half of it every single day and leaving the empty tub back on the shelf. I switched to a locked lunch bag. Gone again, bag and all. So I bought the exact same brand of yogurt everyone in that fridge seemed to love, added two tablespoons of hot sauce only I could handle, and labeled it in huge letters: special diet, do not eat. Within an hour our shared kitchen chat exploded with someone demanding to know who, quote, poisoned the yogurt. I said nothing. She confessed first, mid-sentence, before anyone even asked her name. HR got looped in about food theft policy, and a sign-out sheet appeared on the fridge door within a day. My lunch has been untouched for two weeks straight. Turns out all it took was one honest label?
